title: WATCH How You Can Ride Out Your Storm | Overcome Trials (Daily Jesus Devotional)
paragraphs: your storms are not punishments ride out your storms and don't think that you need to just survive God wants you to thrive evolve and shine today his reassuring voice tells us in Psalm 107 verse 29. he calms the storm so that its waves are still we're also going to pray a powerful prayer with you calling on God to help you stand firm amidst the storms of life and to bless you abundantly in the name of Jesus so watch until the end

and open your heart to receive the blessings of this prayer from the dawn of our existence one undeniable fact emerges life brings its challenges imagine you are standing at the foot of a towering Mountain its peak hidden by The Mists of uncertainty now Envision a gentle light at the top of that mountain calling you forward promising hope and warmth this light my dear friends represents our unshakable faith and the ever-present Embrace of God no matter how steep our climb or treacherous

our journey every obstacle diminishes and hope shines brightest when we set our sights on that Guiding Light Above now let us seek to further understand the nature of life's storms storms Brew in every life of course these are not just the rain that dampens our clothes but trials that test our spirit and resolve the Bible tells us in James 1 verses 2 to 3 my brethren counted all joy when you fall into various trials knowing that the testing of your faith

produces patience trials are not meant to break us but to mold us to prove our faith and to bring us closer to God the most defining moments of Our Lives often come during these challenging times but many of us yearn for a life without problems wishing that challenges would simply vanish this is a comforting illusion it is simply a dream of continuous smooth sailing but that's not a reality life isn't an endless parade of sunny days the belief that it should

be is a refusal of the fact that challenges help us to grow and become stronger life is also about braving storms and emerging stronger it's high time to wake up from the Slumber of complacency and face the reality of the connection between triumphs and trials sometimes storms are here to clear our paths remove the trash and distractions and guide us towards our true purpose it's during these storms that we must remember the words of Psalm 46 verses 1 to 2. God

is our refuge and strength a very present help and trouble therefore we will not fear even though the Earth be removed and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea so as we journey through life we must strive to find purpose in our storms instead of asking why is this happening to me perhaps the question should be what can I learn from this oh and maybe you're thinking I don't want to learn anything well consider this how can

you claim victory when you've never had to overcome how can you claim healing if you were never sick how can you appreciate the warmth of daylight if you've never endured the cold silent Embrace of night every challenge we face every obstacle we overcome adds depth of substance to our story these trials Are Not Mere interruptions they are vital chapters enriching our story of life we're not saying you should seek hardships not at all but it's about recognizing that storms are a

reality of life and using them as stepping stones rather than stumbling blocks life's lessons aren't just about the hard times but about how we get up and move forward facing problems and learning from them makes us stronger and wiser can you think of a trial that you have already overcome that made you stronger we all certainly can if we think long enough maybe you could think about a past relationship or friendship that didn't work out that you may have thought was

the best thing at the time yet you can look back and realize that you're happy that it didn't work out I'm sure we can all think of something so even if you feel like you don't want to learn anything know that life's lessons have a way of teaching us things that we didn't even know we needed by facing them head on we not only grow wiser but also richer in spirit and experience remember it's The Valleys as much as the Peaks

that shape the landscape of Our Lives embrace them both and you'll find a profound sense of purpose and fulfillment you never thought possible when finding the purpose in our storms often the answers aren't immediate but in hindsight the lessons are clear think again about Joseph sold into slavery by his brothers falsely accused and imprisoned his life was a series of misfortunes yet in Genesis 50 verse 20 he acknowledges but as for you you meant evil against me but God meant it

for good every hardship he faced was preparation for his Destiny to save many people from famine and I can promise you this any storm you're facing today is also preparing you for your destiny let me just share a quick testimony with you I was working for a company for over five years and I badly needed a promotion I prayed about it again and again but year after year I was denied a job promotion despite getting an outstanding annual performance appraisal until

finally one day I had a unique conversation with the Holy Spirit and he spoke to my heart and challenged me that if I stayed I would be choosing fear and if I left I would be choosing faith so what do you think I did I chose Faith over fear I decided to quit my job and guess what and quitting I was led into a totally different direction that brought more meaning blessings and fulfillment in my life today I'm thankful that I

was denied a promotion year after year I am truly grateful for those storms without those storms it most certainly would have led me to complacency and I never would have been able to walk into my god-given destiny God is good he works in mysterious ways he is faithful we just need to trust him ride out your storms now please note that I'm not telling you to quit your job in my case I was very sure that I was being led by

the spirit I am just sharing my personal story here moreover our trials often build character and resilience which we wouldn't develop in calm Waters the Bible reminds us in Romans 5 verse 3 to 4. and not only that but we also glory in tribulations knowing that tribulation produces perseverance and perseverance character and character hope these storms might seem endless but they come with a promise a promise of growth strength and renewed Faith listen to this when we are in the eye

of the storm it's crucial to remember our past triumphs each of us has faced difficulties before and by God's grace have overcome them these past experiences serve as testimonies to our strength and resilience David before facing Goliath remembered how he killed a lion and a bear while protecting his father's sheep this memory fortified his faith as recorded in first Samuel 17 37. moreover David said the Lord who delivered me from the Paw of the lion and from the Paw of the

bear he will deliver me from the hand of this philistine because you're here listening today whether you recognize it or not your track record for weathering adversities stands at 100 percent we've all been down but never out we're still here these triumphs Are Not Mere tales of the past but blueprints for our future victories they remind us that with God on our side there's no challenge to insurmountable you can ride out your storm don't give up now perhaps one of the

most reassuring truths in our Christian Journey is that God's presence isn't reserved for peaceful times he's there even in the heart of the storm let us look again at the story of Shadrach Meshach and Abednego they were cast into a fiery furnace for refusing to bow to a golden idol but they were not alone a fourth figure was seen with them and they emerged unharmed Daniel 3. verse 25 States look I see four men loose walking in the midst of the

fire and they are not hurt and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God God's presence was their Shield when we feel overwhelmed lost in the noise we must cling to this truth God is with us the waters might rise the fires might burn but his presence is a protective Fortress around our hearts he not only watches from a distance but walks with us hand in hand leading us to safety so our journey of faith is purposed with

moments where we must choose between faith and fear we all have to choose at some point it's easy to let the Towering waves of doubt and fear Cloud our vision but we must fix our eyes on Jesus in Matthew 14 31 when Peter began to sink while walking on water towards Jesus our lord immediately reached out his hand and caught him saying O you of little faith why did you doubt this instance reminds us that Faith requires our undivided focus on

the Savior Every Storm no matter how prolonged eventually ends our role is not to predict the weather but to have unwavering faith in the one who controls it faith is the Bedrock that sustains us reassuring us that after the darkest night the dawn will come now enduring storms is important it doesn't only bring us through them it also empowers us for the journey ahead think about the Apostle Paul Shipwrecked beaten imprisoned and often left for dead he endured all for the

sake of the Gospel yet he writes in second Corinthians 12 10. therefore I take pleasure in infirmities in reproaches and needs and persecutions in distresses for Christ's sake for when I am weak then I am strong his endurance was not a sign of defeat but a testament to the empowerment that comes from unwavering faith in God it's essential to remember that endurance is not passive acceptance but active resistance against despair trusting that God's plans for us are good through endurance our

spiritual muscles are strengthened preparing us for bigger challenges and leading us to Greater victories our journey through life's storms is also greatly influenced by our foundation those grounded in God's word and love find the strength to withstand the fiercest storms Jesus illustrates this in Matthew 7 verses 24 to 25. therefore whoever hears these sayings of mine and does them I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock and the rain descended the floods came and

the winds blew and beat on that house and it did not fall for it was founded on the rock so a life rooted in God's teachings is unshakable no matter the external circumstances building a solid foundation requires time effort and dedication it's a continuous process of seeking God's wisdom embedding his word in our hearts and leaning on him during trying times this Foundation ensures that come what may we remain unmovable always abounding in the work of the Lord it ensures that

we ride out our Storms remember every storm has an end and with it comes a promise of a fresh start the sky's clear The Sun Shines and the world appears rejuvenated Lamentations 3 verse 22 to 23 says through the Lord's mercies we are not consumed because his compassions fail not they are new every morning great is your faithfulness this renewal is not just of the world around us but our spirit within life storms might bend us but rarely break us after

every storm There's an opportunity for growth reflection and New Beginnings as we emerge from our challenges we're often wiser more compassionate and More in tune with God's purpose for our lives the trials of Life are many but so are the promises of God with faith as our Compass the holy spirit is our Helper and the word of God as our map we can ride out any storm and remember in every challenge God is not just watching over us he's walking with

us so don't ever give up ride out your storm now to all those within the sound of my voice let us go to the Lord in prayer I want you to pray this prayer with me so that you can have all the blessings of this prayer let us pray to our gracious and loving God Heavenly Father merciful god your power knows no bounds and your love for us is Everlasting Lord I humbly ask for your forgiveness as I forgive all those

who trespass against me Father may you forgive me for times when I have let the storms of life overshadow my trust in you forgive me for moments when fear clouded My Faith Lord may you cleanse my heart and spirit from all unrighteousness and renew my trust in your unchanging love in the mighty name of Jesus I declare strength and courage to face every storm that comes my way I declare peace and wisdom to Journey Through the turbulent Waters of life I

rebuke every spirit of fear doubt anxiety despair and discouragement that seeks to attack me in the name of Jesus father I declare perfect health Over My Body Mind and Spirit in the name of Jesus I ask that you surround me with your Shield of protection guarding me from all harm Lord may you release your Abundant Blessings into every area of my life ensuring that your grace will always provide I also lift up all my loved ones dear Lord may they come

to experience your grace faithfulness and love Lord may you guide them through their personal storms and fill them with hope and courage father as I say this prayer together with everyone listening I thank you for the hearts that are open to you right now I pray that a wave of Peace will surround us Lord may we have an unwavering faith that drowns out our fears may we stand firm hand in hand anchored in your love and Promises ensuring that no storm

can drift us away from your Embrace in the mighty name of Jesus I pray amen if you were blessed by this message type the word amen in the comment section below I declare that all the blessings of this prayer are now upon you in the name of Jesus you can help us to reach more persons and spread the gospel you can do this by sharing the video with a friend or family member who you know need the blessing of this prayer

and by clicking the like button also remember to subscribe to the channel for more videos that will bless your heart and uplift your spirit we appreciate all those who support us you're blessed to be a blessing please feel free to leave your prayer request in the comments section so that we can present them before God for your blessings and victory we also invite other believers on the YouTube platform and all over the world to join us and start praying for you

right now and we want you to know that even if you don't see a reply to your prayer request it doesn't mean that you were not prayed for rest assured we are actively lifting up each request to God that is in accordance with his will we believe in the power of prayer to bring comfort healing and guidance in accordance with God's perfect plan stand in faith with us while we pray God be all the glory May the grace and peace of
our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all
